system_thesis_interpretation: V5 preserves the narrow development-only question and the complete hash-bound V4 scientific protocol: correctness-selected child-authored endpoint targets on sixteen seen tool-by-mode keys per engineered root, complementary matched writes, fixed estimators and thresholds, bounded spill families, and no inference to autonomous credit assignment, unseen-key generalization, capacity, retention, qualification, parenting, C11, or a population. Its four intended systems deltas are the right ones and introduce no model, data, dose, workload, or claim change. The proposal nevertheless needs authority-metadata rework before implementation ratification: its per-test gate fields and review-role declaration do not preserve the stricter inherited pre-execution boundary. No present scientific result or execution authority follows from these bytes.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph now represents the four V4 consensus repairs directly. RUNNING becomes the residual post-source nonterminal state; source, fit, and evaluation dispatchers become distinct capability holders; the selector can compute canonical IDs and dereference only selected immutable payloads; and global run timing is separated from root-local label eligibility. The evaluation edge is well factored: after final admission and four commits, the selector verifies the bank root and selected entry hashes, emits stable immutable call envelopes, and the evaluation dispatcher consumes exactly one envelope without direct access to maps, admission, the bank, training material, history, prior results, or scores. Source and fit dispatcher prose also defines frozen phase-minimal inputs and single-purpose outputs, with explicit denial of reseeding, reordering, cross-phase aliasing, logging leaks, and feedback. One construction edge remains underspecified: a selected execution call must contain the committed adapter identity and hash, while the selector's adapter-stage visibility is only a derived barrier result; the artifact does not say whether that result carries the exact identities and hashes needed to build the call.
loop_delta_interpretation: The loop remains causally ordered and fail closed: seal all candidate evaluation material before source; acquire source without result-dependent repair; finalize per-root admission; compile exact admitted endpoints; commit all four isolated adapters; select and dereference only admitted evaluation entries; execute immutable calls through phase-specific dispatchers; and score only immutable downstream results. The five run statuses form a disjoint and exhaustive partition over the declared reachable lifecycle: source_started=false separates PLANNED from terminal preflight NOT_RUN; after source begins, two non-null root labels give TERMINAL_LABELED, otherwise terminal_stop selects STOPPED_UNLABELED and its absence selects residual RUNNING. This covers compilation, fitting preparation, the commit barrier, selection, post-commit/pre-evaluation checkpoints, and all quiescent inter-stage intervals. Run-global first-source timing controls lifecycle, while each root's own first-source receipt alone permits SOURCE_INVALID for that root; a fault in an untouched mate leaves it NOT_STARTED with a null label and stops the run without fabricating science. No partial root, pooled result, retry adaptation, substitute root, or incomplete lifecycle can become completed evidence.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim remains future, conditional, and development-only. A permitted reading still requires two non-null MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS labels and every inherited V4 source, optimization, oracle, interface/flood, binding, spill, exact-binary64, fixed-panel, workload, and visibility gate, now augmented by the V5 lifecycle and dispatcher receipts. The proposal correctly creates neither a present result nor a broader claim and keeps headline_eligible false. Because the recorded test timing and reviewer roles currently understate the inherited authority gate, future numerical success alone would not make the claim eligible until corrected bytes complete deliberation, exact implementation-only ratification, bounded implementation and CPU/fault receipts, the mandated implementation reviews, an immutable execution manifest, and separate exact human execution ratification.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The inherited-plus-delta visibility product is structurally exact. The first ten information items, first twelve principals, and all 120 inherited cells are identical to V4. Adding selected_execution_call and three dispatcher principals contributes exactly 45 cells, producing 11 by 15 equals 165 unique pairs with no unknown, duplicate, or missing cell. Source execution can see only its own continuing public trajectory and source capability; fit execution can see only committed compiled rows, its own adapter stage state, and fit capability; evaluation execution can see only one selected call, its required capability, and the immutable result it writes. All three are denied direct raw map, admission, full-bank, held-prompt, cross-phase, prior-result, and scorer access as applicable. Generators see only call-derived prompt or continuation bytes and hidden mounts, while the selector alone sees admission plus the sealed bank and may expose only hash-verified selected entries. This closes the V4 dispatcher and index-versus-payload defects subject to making the adapter identity/hash provenance of each selected call explicit and mutation-tested.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 appropriately inherits deterministic geometry, complete-bank, seed, workload, and call-graph checks and adds immutable phase-envelope identity, hash, condition, seed, and order checks. T02 explicitly targets the exact 165-cell product, selected-only dereference, unselected denial, and dispatcher ingress, alias, metadata, exception, cache, log, filename, and feedback paths. T03 covers the Cartesian combinations of global and per-root source start, including the R0-started/R1-untouched terminal. T04 and T05 preserve mirror geometry and the total raw-byte/parser overlays. T06 adds exactly-one status fixtures at pre-source, source, compile, barrier, selection, post-commit, evaluation, stopped, and labelled checkpoints without changing any numeric reducer. T07 combines inherited path/retry/capability tests with dispatcher isolation, envelope mutation, residual RUNNING, and untouched-root faults. T08 correctly requires fresh review of identical bytes, but specifies two independent reviewers instead of the repository contract's fresh independent reviewer plus separate author-side scientific advocate. In addition, the architecture records T04, T05, T06, and T08 as required only before gpu_run, whereas the inherited V4 section 13 requires T01-T07, the immutable manifest, independent review, advocate PASS, and exact human ratification before any model, tokenizer, source, benchmark, fit, adapter, or GPU execution. This static interpretation ran only schema, hash, product, and inheritance checks; it did not run the proposal's unauthorized deterministic materialization/fault suite or any model, tokenizer, trainer, source, adapter, subprocess, device, network, or GPU operation.
assumptions: A visibility cell marked visible for a dispatcher is instance-scoped to that dispatcher's one bound request or fit and does not grant access to other sessions, rows, adapters, calls, or results in the same information category.
The V4 scientific parameters and reducer semantics remain authoritative wherever V5 is silent, because V5 exact_scope.md binds and expressly preserves V4 exact_scope.md at its verified SHA-256.

ambiguities.question: Does the four-commit barrier result supplied derivatively to trusted_evaluation_selector contain the exact committed adapter identities and hashes needed for each selected_execution_call, or is another immutable mapping edge intended?
ambiguities.impact: Without an explicit source and equality check for these fields, implementations can disagree about who binds the mounted adapter; a selector could be unable to construct the required envelope or could use a stale or mismatched adapter hash despite the four-commit condition.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The required_before metadata for MWG5_T04, MWG5_T05, MWG5_T06, and MWG5_T08 does not preserve the inherited pre-model-execution gate.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Those records say gpu_run, but the hash-bound V4 section 13 requires every T01-T07 receipt and the later manifest/review/ratification chain before any model, tokenizer, source, benchmark, fit, adapter, or GPU execution. The V5 preservation rule says this authority boundary is unchanged. A CPU model or tokenizer invocation, or any source call before these checks, would satisfy the JSON's weaker field while violating the normative base.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Change MWG5_T04, MWG5_T05, MWG5_T06, and MWG5_T08 required_before to model_execution, and state explicitly that all T01-T07 receipts plus T08's review roles and exact human execution ratification gate every model/tokenizer/source/fit/adapter invocation regardless of device.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: MWG5_T08 replaces the required independent-reviewer plus author-side-scientific-advocate pairing with two independent reviewers.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The repository operating contract and inherited V4 section 13 require a fresh independent reviewer and a separate author-side scientific advocate, with the advocate unable to override rejection. Two independent reviewers are useful but do not discharge the distinct advocate role, so the V5 claim that the authority boundary is unchanged is false as written.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Restore T08 to require one fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate author-side scientific advocate on identical immutable bytes and T01-T07 receipts, both PASS, with independent rejection controlling; any additional independent reviewer may be additive rather than a replacement.
